description: Shorti(쇼티) for «what has nobody shot yet?» or «아직 아무도 안 찍은 거 뭐 있어?». The arena's open spots, first recorded takes, later breakouts and entrant standings. view='spots': open spots, their words, dates and how to shoot; 'board': first takes and finds; 'entrant': one entrant's standing. Unread: not_run, never an empty board.
